short_bio: Musician and songwriter, co-writer and bassist of the Beatles.
biography:
Paul McCartney was born in Liverpool in 1942. He met John Lennon in 1957, and the pair wrote most of the Beatles’ songs, among them Yesterday, Hey Jude and Let It Be. The group split in 1970.

He formed Wings in 1971; Band on the Run (1973) was their best-known album. Later projects included the classical piece Liverpool Oratorio (1991).

He was knighted in 1997 and made a Companion of Honour. He headlined Glastonbury in 2022, and the 2021 documentary The Beatles: Get Back revisited the group’s final years.
